title: AgentPoison: Red-teaming LLM Agents via Poisoning Memory or Knowledge Bases
book_use: The paper demonstrates a backdoor-style attack against generic and retrieval-augmented agents by poisoning long-term memory or knowledge bases so that later retrieval changes agent behavior. The manuscript uses it to establish persistent memory as a security boundary distinct from one-session prompt injection.; Caveat: Benchmark and attack results come from experimental agent setups and should not be interpreted as an estimate of real-world incident frequency.
